scope: First substantive pass for Gouda, Gulpen-Wittem, Haaksbergen, Halderberge, Hardenberg and Harderwijk.

records.finding: Official regulation search surfaced Beleidsregels kamerverhuur en woningsplitsen with detailed criteria, but that instrument is explicitly expired from 20-02-2026. It is therefore not encoded as current law. Historical criteria included one/two-room owner-occupied kamerverhuur and splitting, with exclusions and GBO thresholds; these are retained only as a strong successor-search lead.
remaining: identify successor/current 2026 framework after expiry on 20-02-2026

records.finding: Current Omgevingsplan CVDR696495 remains the controlling generic spatial source. No municipality-specific current room-rental/splitting instrument was safely established in this first search, so no rule from another municipality is imported.
Current Omgevingsplan CVDR696197 remains controlling. First official-source sweep did not yet establish a reliable current municipality-wide splitting/room-rental instrument suitable for encoding.
Current Omgevingsplan CVDR696469 remains controlling. First official-source sweep did not yet establish a safe current municipality-wide room-rental/splitting framework.

Current Omgevingsplan CVDR696200 remains controlling. First sweep did not yet expose a reliable current municipality-wide ordinary splitting/room-rental framework, so the case remains open for targeted direct-plan/integrated-component and application-route research.

Huisvestingsverordening gemeente Harderwijk 2026 is current from 01-01-2026 and explicitly states that the municipality currently does NOT use the Huisvestingswet powers to make withdrawal, merging, conversion, woningvorming or splitting of the housing stock permit-required. Onzelfstandige woonruimte is also excluded from the general housing-permit allocation requirement. This does not remove possible Omgevingsplan/Omgevingswet permission requirements; those remain a separate spatial check.
remaining: current Omgevingsplan rules for room rental/splitting

quality.importantLegalDistinction: Harderwijk 2026 Huisvestingsverordening positively says no housing-stock-change permit system is used under that regulation; spatial Omgevingsplan permission remains separate.
